messages:
james_support: Hey team — customer reported GitHub SSO failing intermittently. Callback returns 400 'missing state' from our auth handler. Happens only when traffic flows through our proxy cluster in eu-west-1. Example redirect URL they hit: `https://app.example.com/auth/callback?code=...&state=gho%2Bxyz%2Babc`

marta_devex: Can you paste the exact raw redirect URL (not the decoded form) and any proxy logs? Might be a char-encoding rewrite.

james_support: Raw captured from the customer's browser (copied from Charles):
```
https://app.example.com/auth/callback;code=abc123;state=gho%2Bxyz%2Babc&session=eyJhbGci...
```
Notice the `?` was replaced with `;` for the first separator and `code` ended up as a path-style param. Our handler looks for `state` in querystring so it misses it. Logged at our edge: `WARN oauth: no state param - rejecting callback` and we return 400.

sam_sre: That `;` instead of `?` screams rewrite by an Envoy header/body modification filter or an older HAProxy rule. ingress-proxy, did anything change overnight?
ingress-proxy: We deployed a small URL-normalizer filter at 2026-02-14T03:12:00Z to canonicalize semicolon usage for legacy backends. It was intended to only touch path params, but I see the filter has a rule: `replace_first('?',';')` when certain headers matched `X-Forwarded-Proto: https`. Oops.
marta_devex: Yikes. That explains it. GitHub uses encoded plus signs (`%2B`) in state sometimes; changing separators can break query parsing. For immediate mitigation: advise customers to URL-encode `state` again (double-encode) or avoid relying on naive parsing. But we should rollback the URL-normalizer.
sam_sre: I'll open a rollback PR and patch the filter to only act on `;` inside the path segment, not the separator. Targeting rollback now.

deploy-bot: deploy started for ingress-proxy rollback (PR #4821) — canary in eu-west-1 first.
james_support: Workaround communicated to customer. They report sign-in works after we routed them around the proxy.
ingress-proxy: Rollback canary succeeded. Full rollback complete at 2026-02-14T03:47:10Z. Filter removed.
marta_devex: Follow-up action: add unit test for redirect parsing (ensure `?` preserved) and add an integration test using a GitHub-style `state` with `+`/`%2B`. Also add a monitoring alert for `oauth: no state param` spikes.
sam_sre: Filed tickets: INF-1294 (rollback), INF-1295 (tests + alert).
james_support: Thanks all — closing the customer escalations ticket after postmortem notes. :thumbsup:
